sn22.98:1.2: Sitting to one side, that bhikkhu said to the Blessed One:
sn22.98:1.7: any consciousness that is permanent, stable, eternal, not subject to change, and that will remain the same just like eternity itself?”
sn22.98:1.12: no consciousness that is permanent, stable, eternal, not subject to change, and that will remain the same just like eternity itself.”
